name: Request, approval and fulfilment
description: Industry-neutral template (synthetic, no customer data): somebody asks for something, it is reviewed, approved by a person above a threshold, fulfilled by a team, and closed after the requester was told.

parameters.question: From which amount must a person approve a request?
parameters.why: Below it the agent may approve on its own; at or above it the request waits for a human reviewer

parameters.question: Which role approves requests at or above that amount?
parameters.why: The review is addressed to a role that a named member must hold before a pilot

parameters.question: Which role handles and fulfils requests?
parameters.why: Only this role may fulfil a request; the agent acts with it

parameters.question: Which system delivers what was requested (for example an ERP, a ticketing tool, a warehouse system)?
parameters.why: Fulfilment acts outside Autology: it needs a tool, first simulated, then a sandbox of that system

items.name: Requester
items.rationale: Somebody asks for something: the brief speaks of requests and of who raises them

value.description: A person or unit that asks for something

items.name: Request
items.rationale: The thing that is asked for, reviewed, approved, fulfilled and closed

value.description: A request to be reviewed, approved and fulfilled

items.name: Team
items.rationale: Requests are fulfilled by a team

value.description: The team that delivers what was requested

items.name: review_request
items.rationale: Every request is looked at before a decision

value.description: Check that the request is complete

items.name: approve_request
items.rationale: A reviewed request is approved before anything is delivered

items.name: reject_request
items.rationale: A reviewed request can be turned down

items.name: fulfil_request
items.rationale: An approved request is delivered by an available team

items.name: notify_requester
items.rationale: The requester is told before the request is closed

value.description: Tell the requester that the request was fulfilled

items.rationale: Approvals at or above the threshold belong to a person

value.description: A {approver_role} approves requests of {approval_threshold} or more

items.rationale: Rejecting a request is a person's decision
The amount decides who approves, so it has a named writer

value.description: Only a {approver_role} changes a request's amount

items.rationale: Nobody is left without news of their request

value.description: The requester is notified before a request is closed
The request was fulfilled and closed

items.name: request_case
items.rationale: A run reads a request with its requester and the team that fulfils it from the records

value.description: A request with its requester and its team

roles.name: {handler_role}
roles.description: Handles requests and fulfils the approved ones; the agent acts with this role

roles.name: {approver_role}
roles.description: Reviewer role: approves requests of {approval_threshold} or more, decides rejections, maintains the amount

agents.name: request_handler
agents.description: Takes a submitted request to closure; stops for a person where the rules ask for one

integrations.description: Delivers what was requested; start with a simulated tool, then a sandbox of the system
Tells the requester; a simulated tool is enough until a channel is chosen

assumptions: Each request has one requester and is fulfilled by one team
The amount of a request is known when it is submitted
unknowns: Deadlines or service levels per category
What happens to a rejected request (appeal, resubmission)

request_handler.purpose: Takes a submitted request to closure
responsibilities: Approve within the policy, or ask the person the policy names
Fulfil, notify the requester and close
